featured_reviews.name: Spoorthi M R
featured_reviews.review_text:
Neelam has done a fantastic job with the book review! Her attention to detail, thoughtful takeaways, and beautifully written blog truly stood out. She brings a lot of passion and consistency to her work, and it clearly reflects in the way she presents the essence of the book.
I absolutely loved working with her, thank you Neelam for the wonderful collaboration.

featured_reviews.name: Pujith Gayon
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the immense pleasure of having my debut book, Once Upon A Blink, reviewed by Neelam, and I couldn't be more thrilled with the experience. She provided an incredibly insightful and thorough review that captured the essence of my collection of flash fictions perfectly.

Neelam's ability to delve deep into the nuances of each story and articulate their thoughts with such clarity and passion is truly commendable. The review was not only comprehensive but also highlighted aspects of my work that I hadn’t considered, giving me a fresh perspective on my own writing.

What stood out the most was Neelam's genuine love for literature and dedication to promoting new authors. She handled my work with the utmost respect and professionalism, making the entire process an absolute delight. I am incredibly grateful for the thoughtful and eloquent review, which has undoubtedly added immense value to my book.

If you are an author looking for a perceptive and articulate reviewer who truly understands and appreciates the art of storytelling, I highly recommend Booxoul. Thank you, Neelam, for your exceptional review and for supporting emerging writers like myself.

Pujith Gayon
Author of Once Upon A Blink

featured_reviews.name: ranjith radhakrishnan
featured_reviews.review_text: Booxoul is a genuine book reviewer. She has credibility, consistency and a real love for reading. I’ve benefitted from her book recommendations before and am sincerely happy that I could get a review from her for my debut novel. Thank you & may you find the words, phrases, passages, pages and books that touch your heart & ignite your mind.

featured_reviews.name: Niti Kewalramani
featured_reviews.review_text: Neelam took her time but delivered an excellent service!  Most reviewers write their reviews in sweeping statements using large brush strokes. Neelam focuses on the minutiae of the story, and that’s when the magic happens.

featured_reviews.name: Abhinav Bhatnagar
featured_reviews.review_text: Though many of the people are telling that these are the professional guys but seriously these are not. First the reviews took months…I paid in January 2022 and yet 2 reviews are still missing…although they compensated with an online Article but don’t know how much helpful was that. Then we got in a contract for pitching my next book to publishers. After wasting more than four months, after hearing so many mountains of self-appraisals these guys abruptly ended the contract claiming that its hard to get the book pitched to anyone. They talk when they want to, they reply to your messages and calls when they want to. Worst and the most unprofessional persons I have ever met. Don’t go by the false claims these guys have posted on their website.

featured_reviews.name: Lvbk viswanath
featured_reviews.review_text: Being the first time contacting the service, I was little hesitant to trust on the book reviewing service due to the outside perception of the service in general. featured_reviews.name: Sushrut Tewari
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are publishers, then there are very good publishers, and then there is StoryMirror.
I have talked with a lot of self publishers, Most are here for money, few are for fame. Out of all, storymirror is the one I chose because i think they're the only professional who treat this industry as an art.

Here's what I have to say about them:
Pros
- Their response time was great
- They provided genuine tips to improve my book quality.
- They do their best to support authors and sell their books.
- They provide all round book support including cover, pagination, formatting and marketing.
- They always communicate the plans (But you also need to take initiative)

Cons:
They have high standards for the books they publish. So if you're an author who cannot take criticism then you're better of with another publishing house.

All in all, I personally found Storymirror as one of the best self publishers I have worked with.
